de.abas.erp.db

Interface FieldValueProvider

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    AbasObject, Deletable, EditableObject, EditableRowRecord<E>, EditorObject, FieldValueSetter, InfosystemObject<E>, Procedure<R>, ProcedureQuery<R>, ProcedureQueryResult<T>, ProcedureResult, RowRecord, RowWithId, SelectableObject, SelectableRecord, SelectableRow, VartabObject

    public interface FieldValueProvider
    Interface for objects which provide field values. All records implement this interface.

    • Method Detail

      • getReference

        <R extends SelectableRecord> R getReference(Class<R> refType,
                                            String fieldName)
        Returns the value of the field fieldName as a database record. This method must only be called on Field with the ERP type ERPType.REFERENCE.
        Type Parameters:
        R - Referenced type
        Parameters:
        refType - Class instance of referenced type
        fieldName - Field name
        Returns:
        A instance of R

      • getDuration

        AbasDuration getDuration(String fieldName)
        Returns the value of the field fieldName as a AbasDuration. This method must only be called on Field with the ERP type ERPType.PERIOD.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field name.
        Returns:
        The value of field 'fieldName' as AbasDuration.
        See Also:
        AbasDuration

      • getDate

        AbasDate getDate(String fieldName)
        Returns the value of the field fieldName as a AbasDate. This method must only be called on Field with the ERP type ERPType.DATE or ERPType.DATETIME.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field name.
        Returns:
        The value of field 'fieldName' as AbasDate, if the field has the ERP Type ERPType.DATE and AbasDateTime, if the ERP type is ERPType.DATETIME and a time is set.
        See Also:
        AbasDate, AbasDateTime

        Returns:

      • getFreeText

        Writer getFreeText(String fieldName,
                   Writer writer)
            throws IOException
        Reads the value of the field fieldName into a Writer. This method must only be called on fields with ERP type ERPType.FREETEXT.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field name.
        writer - Writer
        Returns:
        Writer instance for method chaining
        Throws:
        IOException - if read of the free text fails

      • getRawString

        String getRawString(String fieldName)
        Returns the value of the field with name fieldName. This method returns the internal string representation. This method can be called on all field types.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field name.
        Returns:
        The value of field 'fieldName' as String.
        If called on field with ERP type ERPType.FREETEXT: *

      • getString

        String getString(String fieldName)
        Returns the value of the field with name fieldName. The returned string representation depends on context settings. This method can be called on all field types.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field name.
        Returns:
        The value of field 'fieldName' as String. If called on field with ERP type ERPType.FREETEXT: *

      • getString

        The value of 'field' as String. If called on field with ERP type ERPType.FREETEXT: *
